verdict.what_is_wrong: From about 14:38:00 to 14:40:03 UTC, app PID 131904 in pid_ns 4026532609 experienced a slow database-path signature: its request-to-answer p50 rose from 0.9 ms in a quiet comparison slice to 418.7 ms, while answers continued arriving. Mysqld in pid_ns 4026533886 had matching ~501.6 ms gaps but little CPU, no meaningful CPU wait or disk sleep, so the evidence points to latency on the path to the database rather than demonstrated strain inside mysqld; toxiproxy is the likely path component, though the trace notes do not prove that it caused the delay.
